entries.name: Pulse Cannon
entries.desc: Fast bolts. Strips shields well, scratches hulls. Costs energy per shot.

entries.name: Seeker Missile
entries.desc: Hold a target in the nose cone to lock. Hits hulls hard, can be fooled by decoys or shot down.

entries.name: Lance Beam
entries.desc: Continuous ray, damage per second. Hold past the overcharge mark for double damage and a lot of heat.
